messages:
elaine: Starting a canary toggle for the feature flag `predictive-routing` in eu-west-1. Plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% (staggered, ~10m checkpoints). Pin routing-svc to v2.3.4 for the canary cohort. Change window now. @oncall-east FYI.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Canary rollout initiated for predictive-routing in eu-west-1. rollout_id=rb-1738801234. Schedule: 1% @t0, 10% @t+10m, 50% @t+30m. Pinned service: routing-svc v2.3.4. Running preflight checks.

sam: Preflight results: DB migrations ✅, smoke traffic ok, latency baseline within 2%. Proceeding with 1% toggle.

natalie: Oncall dashboards: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/abcd123/predictive-routing?orgId=1 :eyes: I'll be watching errors & p95.

deploy-bot: Action: `ffctl set predictive-routing --region=eu-west-1 --percentage=1 --rollout-id=rb-1738801234`
-> output: success (applied to 1% traffic).

oncall-east: Noted a small bump in 5xx at 1% (0.35% -> 0.9%). Error budget still ok. Rollback threshold set: error_rate >= 1.5% sustained for 120s -> fast-disable.

mike: If it keeps climbing I'd prefer to disable the flag first (`ffctl set predictive-routing off`) then, if needed, rollback routing-svc to v2.3.3. Avoid full service rollback unless required.

elaine: Agreed. Rollback plan: 1) Fast-disable flag in region, 2) if errors persist pin traffic back to v2.3.3 via `/ops/deploy rollback routing-svc --to v2.3.3 --region eu-west-1`. We'll hold 5m at 1% before next step.

natalie: I'll mute noisy alerts and only open an incident if thresholds breach. Updating runbook notes.

deploy-bot: Telemetry check @t+5m: error_rate=0.95% (1m window), p95 latency +10ms vs baseline. No automatic rollback triggered. Scheduling 10% at +2m.

sam: Applying 10% now.

deploy-bot: Action: `ffctl set predictive-routing --region=eu-west-1 --percentage=10 --rollout-id=rb-1738801234`
-> output: success.

oncall-east: Monitoring... error_rate now ~1.2% (1m), p95 +18ms. Still below 1.5% threshold, but keep close. If >1.5% for 120s we fast-disable.

elaine: Quick reference commands in thread:
- fast-disable: `ffctl set predictive-routing --region=eu-west-1 --percentage=0 --rollout-id=rb-1738801234`
- service rollback: `/ops/deploy rollback routing-svc --to v2.3.3 --region eu-west-1`

mike: Adding to release notes: "predictive-routing canary in eu-west-1, routing-svc v2.3.4 pinned for canary; watch eu-west-1 errors/p95." I'll include on-call contacts.

natalie: :thumbsup: I'll post periodic updates. Go/no-go checkpoint at t+20m for 50% shift.

deploy-bot: Status update t+12m: 10% stable, no auto-rollback. Next scheduled step: 50% at t+18m.

elaine: Thanks — if anything changes DM me and post here. I'll finalize release notes after reaching 50%.

oncall-east: Copy. Will escalate if error_rate >1.5% for 2m or p95 >50% above baseline.

sam: Recent canary log snippet:
```
2026-03-21T22:12:34Z routing: decision=predicted route_id=abc123 latency_ms=12 success=true
```
Looks normal.

natalie: No action needed right now. Leaving alerts at low sensitivity and will update at t+30m.
